title: CS1-SAB with an absorbed comparator-ordered envelope E

claims.statement: For every integer N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, put n = ceil(log2 N). The single CS1-SAB algorithm in proof.md recovers the whole s with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies. On EVERY branch, including failures, retries, discards and aborts, total charged sequential work is T = O(n^(7/2) 2^(sqrt(2n))) (proof.md (13.6)), hence T = O(E(n)), where E(n) = 2^(a sqrt(n) - sum_(i=1..28) k_i n^(1/2) (log2 n)^(-1/(10^256 - i))), with k_1 = ... = k_27 = 10^256 - 1, k_28 = 10^58 - 1, and a = u_333/v_333 > sqrt(2) the exact Pell rational of proof.md Section 0 (the same coefficient appears verbatim in the structured object, which lists E term by term). Lemma 14.1 of proof.md (absorption, using only a - sqrt(2) > 0) proves that n^P 2^(sqrt(2n)) = O(E(n)) for every fixed P. All four resource bounds and tolerance hold jointly for the same configuration, with absolute outside constants. The declared envelope is E(n); its exact growth index is 1/2.

The single CS1-SAB algorithm in proof.md recovers the whole s with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies. On EVERY branch, including failures, retries, discards and aborts, fresh source acquisitions, including every discarded and rejected copy, are at most the explicit Qcap = O(n^(5/4) 2^(sqrt(2n) - 16 (2n)^(1/4))) on the main branch (proof.md (13.2)) and N(n+10) on the finite branch, hence Q = O(E(n)), where E(n) = 2^(a sqrt(n) - sum_(i=1..28) k_i n^(1/2) (log2 n)^(-1/(10^256 - i))), with k_1 = ... = k_27 = 10^256 - 1, k_28 = 10^58 - 1, and a = u_333/v_333 > sqrt(2) the exact Pell rational of proof.md Section 0 (the same coefficient appears verbatim in the structured object, which lists E term by term). Lemma 14.1 of proof.md (absorption, using only a - sqrt(2) > 0) proves that n^P 2^(sqrt(2n)) = O(E(n)) for every fixed P. All four resource bounds and tolerance hold jointly for the same configuration, with absolute outside constants. The declared envelope is E(n); its exact growth index is 1/2.

The same CS1-SAB configuration proves source error tolerance epsilon(n)=0. Every acquired source copy must be an independent ideal coset state. Under that promise, full-secret success is at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 for every N and s, jointly with all four branchwise resource bounds. No positive malformed fraction is claimed.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
